notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B productivity SaaS. Building contextual in-app assistant and improved support routing. Heavy focus on latency for US customers.
Primary ask: Start on Hosted API to validate UX, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Roadmap expects Dedicated by end of Q1 if POC passes.
Workload profile: chat-heavy (coaching assistant) with embeddings for doc search. Average context window ~3k tokens; peak concurrent QPS ~40-60; spike to 120 for quarterly product launches.

Latency SLO: 95p end-to-end <= 150ms for short-turn chat (<=256 tokens). Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to commit for 6-12 month term if predictable pricing reduces TCO by >=30% vs hosted pay-as-you-go.
Security: Okta SSO required, org-managed KMS keys for token encryption, audit logs retention 90 days, US data residency. Need SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence (we provided security FAQ link).

POC ask (explicit): Dedicated POC with canary rollout plan: start 5% traffic to canary pool (quantized variant), monitor latency/error/quality, then ramp. Fallback plan to Hosted small-model in another region on capacity or quality regressions.

Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-curated variants. Testing two variants: 1) polished fp16 model (baseline), 2) int8 quantized variant for cost/throughput. Want automated routing between variants by latency and token-cost budget.
Canary success metrics: latency 95p within +10ms of baseline, no >2% drop in intent classification accuracy on evaluation set, error rate <0.5%.

Rollback triggers: sustained latency >200ms for 5m, quality regression >3% on key prompt set, or increased error rate >1% absolute. Need automatic rollback policy in Redwood console and a manual kill-switch.

Regional failover: primary region us-west; plan to test failover to us-east and eu-west. Expect less-than-60s RTO for routing switch in test. Want routing policy that prefers in-region Dedicated, falls back to hosted regionally compatible models.
Networking: customer will require VPC peering + minimal NAT egress. Engineering note: need exact CIDR ranges and peering window during POC (blocker until VPC peering is scheduled).
Quote from product head: "We need predictable tail latency — customers notice 200ms+ spikes. If Dedicated gives consistent sub-150ms with comparable costs, we can accelerate rollout."
Competitive pressures: evaluating Redwood vs OpenAI managed endpoints + potential internal hosting. Key differentiators are Dedicated SLA, routing/fallback controls, and transparent cost levers.
Next admin: security review due 2025-02-25. Finance to approve commit level after POC. AE to provide sample committed pricing for 2 GPU pools + burst capacity.

technical_summary: Primary endpoints: chat generation + embedding calls. Expect average response tokens 80-200 for assistant flows.
Autoscaling profile: bursty - maintain steady baseline for product sessions; prefer predictive autoscaling with guardrails to avoid cold starts.
Caching: customer interested in prefix/KV cache for repeated prompts (support flows). Redwood Optimize suggestions requested for caching config.
Fallback architecture: route to hosted lower-cost quantized model in same region when Dedicated capacity exhausted; failover to another region hosted endpoint if regional outage.
Monitoring/ops: need per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, alerting for quality regressions tied to eval prompt sets.
